request.style: Instrumental guitar rock. Instrumental alternative rock trio, live drum kit, electric bass and interlocking electric guitars. A tense clean offset-guitar hook in a small room grows into broken grunge backbeats and heavy syncopated open-string downstrokes. Tuneful picked guitar against the low riff, bass moves through the spaces in the kick. A quiet suspended turn, a developed fuzz lead with bent notes and breathing phrases, then a full-band return and a ringing natural ending. Wide shoegaze feedback only at peaks, warm live studio dynamics. All melody is played on instruments.

request.style: Instrumental guitar rock. A compact ninety-second instrumental by a live alternative rock band. Clean angular guitar hook, then heavy low guitar and syncopated bass against a dry, expressive drum kit. Grunge grit and short bursts of shoegaze feedback. The opening melody opens up into a short, lyrical bent-note lead guitar solo. One final full-band return resolves to a decisive last chord with the guitar amp ringing out. Guitar, electric bass and drums.

request.style: Instrumental alternative rock, heavy grunge guitar trio recorded live. Electric bass and real drums make the low riff move, with uneven snare answers and space around the attacks. Start with a clean guitar figure, let the same riff widen in a warm dirty guitar sound. A quiet break exposes the pick and strings, followed by an expressive lead guitar passage with sustained bent notes and answering toms. Brief shoegaze noise behind the loudest band moment, then a decisive final band chord and amplifier decay. Pure guitar, bass and drums.
